title: ProjectProfile
description: Structured output of the Enhance step. Schema-validated by Zod in packages/core/src/profile/schema.ts. This JSON Schema is the canonical reference; the Zod schema is derived from it.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema, e.g. '1.0'. Used for forward-compatibility checks.

projectType.description: Short archetype identifier used by the phase builder and strategy applicability engine.

overview.description: Human-readable project overview (1-3 paragraphs). Written by the Enhance LLM call.

techStack.description: Languages and frameworks detected or declared.

llm.description: LLM usage characteristics extracted from the project description. These fields drive phase derivation and strategy applicability predicates.

providers.description: Provider ids referenced in this project.

usesRag.description: True if the project uses retrieval-augmented generation.

usesAgents.description: True if the project uses autonomous LLM agents.

agentCount.description: Number of distinct agent roles, if usesAgents is true.

avgPrefixTokens.description: Average number of tokens that are stable prefix content (enables cache-prefix strategies). Required for caching strategy applicability.

avgPromptTokens.description: Average total input token count per LLM call (including system prompt, context, and user message).

avgOutputTokens.description: Average output token count per LLM call.

avgConversationTurns.description: Average number of turns in a multi-turn conversation, if applicable.

usesStructuredOutput.description: True if the project extracts structured JSON from LLM responses.

usesBatchProcessing.description: True if the project uses or could benefit from batch API calls.

usesFunctionCalling.description: True if the project uses tool/function calling.

components.description: Major architectural components of the project.

llmRole.description: How this component interacts with LLMs, if at all.

dataFlow.description: Prose description of how data flows through the system, particularly the LLM call paths.

phases.description: BUILD and RUNTIME phases proposed by Enhance and verified or edited by the user (FR-052). They drive estimation and strategy pre-selection.

scale.description: Runtime scale assumptions used by the estimation engine for RUNTIME track calculations.

requestsPerDay.description: Expected number of LLM-touching requests per day at baseline load.

peakMultiplier.description: Peak traffic multiplier applied to requestsPerDay for the 'high' cost range.

monthlyDays.description: Working days per month used for monthly cost projection.

buildAssumptions.description: BUILD track assumptions used by the estimation engine.

teamSize.description: Number of developers using AI coding assistance.

sprintWeeks.description: Total weeks of AI-assisted development planned.

iterationsPerFeature.description: Average number of AI-assisted iterations per feature or component.

constraints.description: Known constraints, e.g. latency SLAs, compliance requirements, context window limits.

profileVersion.description: Monotonically incrementing version number. Each Enhance run produces profileVersion + 1.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this profile version was created.

finalizedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the user marked this version as final. Absence means still draft.
